summary: Root-specific staging, producing-pass joins and root-specific cleanup address the two prior overlap mechanisms in source. Three distinct accounting defects remain in reconciliation. Known timestamp/migration/legacy-path work is excluded. Store below means Sources/DiskStewardCore/EvidenceStore/EvidenceStore.swift within the frozen snapshot.

findings.claim: Replacement accounting assumes a one-to-one object relationship. Baseline old O=10 bytes linked at /a and /b; replace those links with distinct new objects N=20 and M=30, leaving O absent. Both replacement events subtract O, producing total +30 instead of +40. Conversely, replacing old A=10 at /a and B=20 at /b with one new object C=30 hard-linked at both paths subtracts only the canonical path's old object, producing +20 instead of 0.
findings.recommendation: Account for each disappeared physical object exactly once across replacement events. Add both cardinality regressions with replacement inodes prepared before unlinking originals; assert event totals against before/after physical totals in both object-ID orders.

findings.claim: An existing object's rename over another existing object loses the displaced object's debit. Baseline A=10 at /a and B=20 at /b; atomically rename /a over /b. A follows the oldObject branch and emits zero-delta rename. B follows hasReplacement and is marked deleted without an event because that branch assumes replacement already accounted for it. Total delta is 0 instead of -20.
findings.recommendation: Suppress a missing object's debit only when an emitted event actually accounts for that object. Add overwrite-by-rename separately from the existing path-swap regression, testing both object orders and exactly one debit for B.

findings.claim: A simultaneous path and size change loses the size delta. Baseline A=10 at /a; move it to /b and grow it to 30 before the next scan. The path-change branch selects rename before comparing metadata, and rename has zero delta. With multiple old links the operation may instead be nil. Current state becomes 30 but the +20 change is absent from history.
findings.recommendation: Handle identity/path transition independently from logical and allocated size changes. Add move-plus-growth and surviving-link-rebase-plus-growth cases; assert accurate size history without duplicate physical accounting.
